subject: Covariate beta.ranef.cont.ele not found in posterior matrix

messages.author: 7eed7eee7dd92cf3
messages.subject: Covariate beta.ranef.cont.ele not found in posterior matrix
parts:
Hi camtrapR users and Jurgen, 

I am facing a strange issue when trying to plot the results of this model.

mod.jags <- communityModel(data_list,
model="Occupancy",
occuCovs = list(ranef = c("ele","area","type")),
detCovsObservation = list(ranef=c("ndays","ndays_squared")),
intercepts = list(det = "ranef", occu = "ranef"),
speciesSiteRandomEffect = list(det = TRUE),
effortCov="effort",
richnessCategories="type",
modelFile="/beegfs/home/sanile/modelfile1.txt",
augmentation = c(maxknown = 60),
keyword_quadratic ="_squared")

summary(mod.jags)
# commOccu object for community occupancy model (in JAGS)
#
# 60 species,  79 stations,  3187 occasions
# 45551 occasions with effort
# Number of detections (by species): 0 - 222
#
# Available site covariates:
#  area, ele, type
#
# Used site covariates:
#  area, ele, type
#
# Available site-occasion covariates:
#  effort, ndays, ndays_squared

The values for  beta.ranef.cont.ele are properly reported when I explore the results  (attached as screenshot) using 

fit.summary<-summary(out) 
DT::datatable(round(fit.summary$statistics, 3))

but when I try to plot the results with
 
plot_effects(object = mod.jags, mcmc.list = out)$type

I got this warning message:
Error: Covariate beta.ranef.cont.ele not found in posterior matrix

Any suggestion is very much appreciated. 

Stef

messages.author: 7eed7eee7dd92cf3
messages.subject: Re: Covariate beta.ranef.cont.ele not found in posterior matrix
parts:
Hi all,

I have been able to understand my mistake. The model file was not exactly as the one used when the model was fit on a cluster computer.
Once I have recreated the exact model file, everything is fine. 

I hope this can help someone else when sending the analysis to some powerful cluster computer.

Stef
